You probably aren’t alone. Logitech’s now-last-gen right-handed mouse is a great PC gaming companion that mimics the feel of mechanical switches with nothing but haptics. You can grab it refurbished through Logitech’s official eBay store for $131.74 (usually $179.99), and for even less with the code PROXPRODUCTS15 applied at checkout. It drops the price to just under $117. Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike Where to Buy: $179.99 $117 at eBay (refurb, w/ code PROXPRODUCTS15) The G Pro X2 Superstrike came out earlier this year, and I went hands-on with it. Logitech’s companion software lets you customize the intensity of the haptics, from an extra punchy click to one that’s barely there (you can also turn the click feel off completely, but that felt a bit strange). The mouse also supports rapid trigger, and when used together with haptics, it lowers the click latency compared to other mice that have mechanical switches. The company followed up recently with the X3 Superstrike , though its differences may not matter much to those who aren’t competitive gamers. The X3 features a more responsive sensor, better battery life, and improved weight distribution. There are some other somewhat small changes to the specs. That said, none of these improvements makes the X2 feel obsolete, and Logitech is continuing to support and sell the mouse. So, if you want to give it a try, now’s your chance to save quite a bit of money on the purchase. Read our hands-on of the X2 Superstrike. ]]> Brad Bourque https://www.theverge.com/?p=1014456 2026-10-20T15:09:35-04:00 2026-10-20T15:09:35-04:00 DJI’s Osmo Pocket 3 is a big upgrade from your phone’s video quality. | Image: The Verge If you’re the kind of person who likes to document everything, either for professional and/or personal reasons, and your phone’s camera isn’t cutting it, you might be considering a dedicated vlogging camera. The DJI Osmo Pocket 3 is discounted to $395 (usually $499) at a variety of retailers, including Amazon , Best Buy , and B&H Photo . The large 1-inch sensor is mounted to a built-in gimbal that offers smooth, stable movement, letting you take impressive videos of your travels, activities, or daily routine. The built-in screen helps you frame shots and check footage on the go without pulling out your phone. DJI Osmo Pocket 3 The Pocket 3 features a 1-inch CMOS sensor, three built-in microphones, and a 2-inch rotatable screen. If you’re unhappy with the video your phone captures, DJI’s compact cam makes it easy to get high-quality, stabilized footage, whether you’re vlogging your adventures or filming a wedding. Read our impressions . Where to Buy: $499 $395 at Amazon $499 $395 at Best Buy $499 $395 at B&H Photo The Pocket 3, like its name implies, is compact enough to easily slide into a pocket or small bag, yet still manages to take high quality video. The results are often compared to pricier dedicated mirrorless digital cameras, delivered without the fuss of tweaking exposure or heavy post-processing. It’s capable of shooting up to 4K at 120 frames per second, and while it has built-in microphones, you can connect it to DJI’s Mic Mini wireless mics. While there is a DJI Osmo Pocket 4, it isn’t officially for sale in the United States. Read our DJI Osmo Pocket 3 review . Other deals to consider You can save $10 on your preorder of Nintendo Switch Sports Resort for the Switch 2 at Amazon , bringing the price down to just $49.94, effectively letting you grab the physical release for the same price as the digital version. This title brings back all the minigames from the original Wii title, including bowling and tennis, plus a new open-world mode that introduces activities like skateboarding, and ships out on October 22nd, 2026. Read our review. The Glorious GMMK 2 mechanical gaming keyboard is steeply discounted at Best Buy , bringing the price down to $48.99 (originally $119.99). The compact 65 percent layout includes just the primary letters and numbers, plus arrow keys and few spares for the delete, page up, page down, and end keys. The kit includes Glorious Fox linear switches, but with hot-swappable sockets, you can easily change them out to suit your preference. Keep your Qi-ready devices topped up with a discounted two-pack of Anker Zolo MagSafe-compatible wireless chargers at Amazon for $25.99 (usually $39.99).
